criteria.realism: Plausible connections, supports, surface continuity, materials and construction details at miniature scale.
criteria.consistency: ORNL palette with requested natural browns and supercomputer cyan; shared pedestals and coordinate convention.
criteria.accuracy: Recognizable broad forms and corrected concrete reference-backed errors; no claim of measured dimensions or exact manufacturer geometry.
criteria.modernness: Clean housings, contemporary display/instrument details and restrained material contrast.
criteria.coolness: Subjective assessment of distinctive silhouettes, focal features and readable details; preserve requested futuristic architecture.
criteria.quality: Four-angle visual inspection plus deterministic regeneration, embedded resources, finite unit normals and Khronos validation.

limitations: Illustrative miniatures, not photogrammetry, manufacturer CAD or surveyed terrain.
Generic research buildings do not represent actual facilities.
Aircraft and separate docks are fitted independently to display pedestals; not shared-scale mechanical assemblies.
Wingtra level-flight and Zipline hover poses retain simplified propulsion/airfoil geometry.
Geospatial instance-performance and game-rule integration are outside this asset review.
